summary: Updated implementation plan elevating 'Toy Circuit: Manzini-Ezulwini Racing' to Forza Horizon and The Crew level of detail: dynamic 24h day/night cycle, tropical downpour weather with wet road reflections, Forza-grade vehicle telemetry (G-meter, tire temp, load, slip angles), deep mechanical tuning suite (gear ratios, camber, dampers, differential lock), active aero spoilers, brake disc glow and exhaust flame pops, speed traps and drift zones, cinematic photo mode with free camera and filters, cockpit camera with working gauges, and traffic combis.
